name: Authorized website migration with rollback
preconditions: Source and destination belong to tenant

steps.action: Compare DNS, PHP/extensions, files, database, quota, mail and cost implications
Create encrypted restorable snapshot and verify checksum
Restore destination and validate application health/data
steps.result: Preview ready or failed with evidence

steps.action: After policy approval, update DNS and monitor

resume_path: Resume from last verified checkpoint only after revalidating source/destination and idempotency state.
rollback_path: Use verified snapshot and prior DNS record set; keep source intact until retention and acceptance gates pass.
